series.basis: Defined in the 2018 Registration Document: 'mining, processing, general and administration, MET, reimbursable services, distribution, toll refining and retrenchment costs'. Later reviews give no formal definition, only a breakdown table (MET, materials, payroll, processing, G&A, selling, other).

series.measure: All-in sustaining cash cost (C1 + capital), attributable
series.basis: Registration Document: 'C1 cash costs plus well construction costs and sustaining costs'. Excludes liquidation-fund contributions and closure costs; from FY2021 the reviews show the capital part as a separate 'Capital cost (attributable basis)' row.

series.measure: Cash cost of produced uranium (average cash cost of production)
series.basis: MD&A: costs 'do not include selling costs such as royalties, transportation and commissions', nor opening-inventory effects; from 2018 also exclude care and maintenance.

series.measure: Total production cost of produced uranium (cash + non-cash)
series.basis: Same table and exclusions as cameco_cash, plus the non-cash (depreciation) cost per pound produced.

series.measure: Average unit cost of sales (including D&A), uranium segment
series.basis: Cost per lb SOLD, not mined: produced and purchased pounds, royalties, selling costs, care and maintenance, depreciation, inventory effects.

series.measure: C1 cost of production, Langer Heinrich (pre-2018 operation)
series.basis: Annual reports: 'cost of production excluding product distribution costs, sales royalties and depreciation and amortisation'.
Sum of the components the deck lists: subsoil use tax, materials, utilities, payroll and related tax, services.
Total Cash Cost plus sustaining mine development, sustaining property and equipment, distribution and G&A (components listed in the deck).

notes: All figures are the producers' own published numbers (annual reports, MD&As, operating and financial reviews, quarterly reports, one investor presentation); no consultant cost curves. Each point cites the document page it was read from; scripts/build_mining_costs.py re-reads every cited page and fails if a typed value is not printed there. Nothing is interpolated. The series are NOT on one basis: Kazatomprom is USD, attributable, tax-inclusive C1 and C1+capital; Cameco is CAD, royalty-exclusive cash and total production cost of its own pounds; Paladin is a site cost per lb produced on a June fiscal year; Boss is AUD and quarterly; Navoiyuran is per lb sold from a presentation. Compare each company with its own past, not levels across companies. Where a company restated a year, v is the later figure and v_first_reported keeps the original.
